domain-information: A client sends a client request to an event planner.
A client reviews the proposed event plan and requests adjustments to the budget.
A client holds a preparation meeting with the event overseer.
An event planner creates a detailed event plan based on the client’s request.
An event planner proposes the plan to the client.
An event planner contacts a venue manager to check availability and request a venue booking.
An event planner coordinates with supplier to arrange catering.
An event planner sends a finalized event schedule to the event overseer.
An event overseer starts the event and ensures it follows it's event plan.
A venue manager confirms the booking and allocates a venue for the event date.
A venue manager ensures the venue is properly prepared according to the event requirements.
A supplier provides the requested catering for the event.
A supplier confirms delivery details with the event planner prior to the event day.
A finance officer issues an invoice to the client after the event is completed.
A finance officer processes payments to supplier and venue manager after receiving service confirmations.
A finance officer updates the company’s financial records with all event-related transactions.

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: Person or organization requesting an event.

domain objects.name: Event Planner
domain objects.description: Professional who designs and coordinates event logistics.

domain objects.name: Event Plan
domain objects.description: Document describing event details, budget, and schedule.

domain objects.name: Budget
domain objects.description: Estimated cost breakdown for the event.

domain objects.name: Client Request
domain objects.description: Initial request containing client’s event requirements.

domain objects.name: Venue Booking
domain objects.description: Reservation of a venue for a specific event date.

domain objects.name: Venue
domain objects.description: Location where the event takes place.

domain objects.name: Event Date
domain objects.description: Scheduled date of the event.

domain objects.name: Venue Manager
domain objects.description: Person responsible for managing and preparing the venue.

domain objects.name: Supplier
domain objects.description: Company providing event services such as catering.

domain objects.name: Event
domain objects.description: Actual occurrence of the organized event.

domain objects.name: Event Schedule
domain objects.description: Timeline outlining event activities and tasks.

domain objects.name: Event Overseer
domain objects.description: Person ensuring event execution follows the plan.

domain objects.name: Catering
domain objects.description: Food and beverage service provided for the event.

domain objects.name: Delivery Details
domain objects.description: Information about time and place for supplier delivery.

domain objects.name: Finance Officer
domain objects.description: Person handling invoices, payments, and financial tracking.

domain objects.name: Invoice
domain objects.description: Bill issued to the client after event completion.

domain objects.name: Payment
domain objects.description: Monetary transaction to settle event-related expenses.

domain objects.name: Preparation Meeting
domain objects.description: Meeting between client and overseer to finalize event details.

domain objects.name: Financial Records
domain objects.description: Company records documenting financial transactions.

associations.description: Client sends Client Request.
Client holds Preparation Meeting to clear event details.
Client Request is received by Event Planner.
Event Planner creates Event Plan.
Client reviews and approves Event Plan.
Event Planner creates Event Schedule.
Event Schedule is sent to Event Overseer.
Event Overseer manages Event execution.
Event Overseer attends Preparation Meeting with Client.
Event Planner coordinates service details with Supplier.
Supplier provides Delivery Details for catering.
Event Planner confirms Delivery Details with Supplier.
Supplier provides Catering for Event.
Catering is served during Event.
Event Planner requests Venue Booking.
Venue Manager confirms Venue Booking.
Finance Officer issues Invoice to Client.
Client receives Invoice for payment.
Finance Officer processes Payment transactions.
Payment is sent to Supplier for services.
Payment is sent to Venue Manager for venue use.
Finance Officer updates Financial Records.
